text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I got word that Oguri-senpai's running in 
the Yasuda Kinen, ss'u!! Getting to battle 
her at my best distance makes me 
ridiculously happy, ss'u!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno's running in that Yasuda Kinen too!! 
I was so pumped that we'd finally get our 
"dream" showdown, but—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno ran off after saying, "Oguri-san 
might end up devouring your 'dream' too, 
you know"!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Trainer told me. They wondered if Yaeno 
was losing her confidence because of how 
incredible Oguri-senpai has been across so 
many distances.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, I want Yaeno to see me 
take on the challenge and show her! That 
Oguri-senpai isn't someone who devours 
dreams...!
